ilha-do-campeche.titulo: Discover the "Brazilian Caribbean": An Exclusive Boat Trip to Ilha do Campeche
ilha-do-campeche.resumo: Skip the lines and rigid schooner schedules: see why arriving by private speedboat is the easiest way to experience the "Brazilian Caribbean."

costa-da-lagoa.titulo: The Secret of Costa da Lagoa: Sailing the Waters of Florianópolis
costa-da-lagoa.resumo: A village reachable only by water, popular restaurants to anchor at and the calm waters of Lagoa da Conceição — the perfect trip for anyone seeking peace and quiet.

caixa-d-aco.titulo: The Coast's Hottest Spot: A Boat Trip to Caixa D'Aço
caixa-d-aco.resumo: Floating bars, the Michel Teló music video and the VIP experience of arriving by private speedboat at Santa Catarina's most sought-after spot.

praia-do-tingua.titulo: A Boaters-Only Hideaway: The Magic of Praia do Tinguá
praia-do-tingua.resumo: Hard to reach by land, this cove is practically reserved for those who arrive by boat — calm sea, seaside dining and few crowds.

praia-de-palmas.titulo: World-Class Waters: Sailing Praia and Ilha de Palmas
praia-de-palmas.resumo: A "Blue Flag" award, crystal-clear water and snorkeling: meet the island that holds the coast's most coveted international quality standard.

Experiencias.subtitulo: Trips, destinations and real stories to help you choose your next boat tour — straight from people who know the Santa Catarina coast.
Experiencias.ctaTexto: Find the right boat and book the trip that matches the experience you want.
